requirements.title: ECG summary on screen within 5 seconds
requirements.design_input: The software shall show the 30-second ECG summary from the {prospect} patch v2 within 5 seconds of the bundle being stored.
requirements.acceptance: Store a synthetic bundle and confirm the 30-second ECG summary is on screen within 5 seconds.

requirements.title: Alert on two high systolic readings
requirements.design_input: The software shall show a visible alert when systolic blood pressure from the {prospect} patch v2 is at or above 180 mmHg on two consecutive readings.
requirements.acceptance: Feed two consecutive synthetic readings at 180 mmHg and confirm a visible alert. Do not assign a safety class here.

requirements.title: Record version and commit in the evidence package
requirements.design_input: The software shall record the software version and the commit of the ECG parser in the evidence package for each verification run.
requirements.acceptance: Run one synthetic verification and confirm the evidence package contains the software version and the commit.

requirements.title: Pairing failure message without a patient identifier
requirements.design_input: The software shall show a pairing-failure message that includes the synthetic error code and the next step, and that includes no patient name, date of birth, or other patient identifier.
requirements.acceptance: Trigger a synthetic pairing failure and confirm the message has the error code and the next step, and no patient name or date of birth.
